build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with parameterized standing sticks, balls, and slopes using define_task_template decorator
add_physics_objects: create static bars and dynamic standingsticks with configurable scale, angle, and position using C.add
update_task_goal: define a PHYRE task goal requiring two balls to be touching using C.update_task with SpatialRelationship
set_solution_tier: set the task metadata to TWO_BALLS solution tier using C.set_meta
skip_template_params: raise SkipTemplateParams to skip invalid parameter combinations when size is 0.8 and distances sum to 0.2 or more
